paragraphs.text: translated by
1. HONOUR the King with thine oblations, Yama, Vivasvan's Son, who gathers men together,
paragraphs.original: परेयिवांसं प्रवतो महीरनु बहुभ्यः पन्थामनुपस्पशानम् ।
paragraphs.translit: pareyivāṃsaṃ pravato mahīranu bahubhyaḥ panthāmanupaspaśānam |

paragraphs.text: Who travelled to the lofty heights above us, who searches out and shows the path to many.
paragraphs.original: वैवस्वतं संगमनं जनानां यमं राजानं हविषा दुवस्य
paragraphs.translit: vaivasvataṃ saṃgamanaṃ janānāṃ yamaṃ rājānaṃ haviṣā duvasya

paragraphs.text: 2. Yama first found for us a place to dwell in: this pasture never can be taken from Us.
paragraphs.original: यमो नो गातुं प्रथमो विवेद नैषा गव्यूतिरपभर्तवा उ ।
paragraphs.translit: yamo no gātuṃ prathamo viveda naiṣā gavyūtirapabhartavā u |

paragraphs.text: Men born on earth tread their own paths that lead them whither our ancient Fathers have departed.
paragraphs.original: यत्रा नः पूर्वे पितरः परेयुरेना जज्ञानाः पथ्या अनु स्वाः
paragraphs.translit: yatrā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ pareyurenā jajñānāḥ pathyā anu svāḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. Mitali prospers there with Kavyas, Yama with Angiras' sons, Brhaspati with Rkvans:
paragraphs.original: मातली कव्यैर्यमो अङ्गिरोभिर्बृहस्पतिर्ऋक्वभिर्वावृधानः ।
paragraphs.translit: mātalī kavyairyamo aṅgirobhirbṛhaspatirṛkvabhirvāvṛdhānaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Exalters of the Gods, by Gods exalted, some joy in praise and some in our oblation.
paragraphs.original: याँश्च देवा वावृधुर्ये च देवान्स्वाहान्ये स्वधयान्ये मदन्ति
paragraphs.translit: yām̐śca devā vāvṛdhurye ca devānsvāhānye svadhayānye madanti

paragraphs.text: 4. Come, seat thee on this bed of grass, O Yama, in company with Angirases and Fathers.
paragraphs.original: इमं यम प्रस्तरमा हि सीदाङ्गिरोभिः पितृभिः संविदानः ।
paragraphs.translit: imaṃ yama prastaramā hi sīdāṅgirobhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Let texts recited by the sages bring thee O King, let this oblation make thee joyful.
paragraphs.original: आ त्वा मन्त्राः कविशस्ता वहन्त्वेना राजन्हविषा मादयस्व
paragraphs.translit: ā tvā mantrāḥ kaviśastā vahantvenā rājanhaviṣā mādayasva

paragraphs.text: 5. Come, Yama, with the Angirases the Holy, rejoice thee here with children of Virupa.
paragraphs.original: अङ्गिरोभिरा गहि यज्ञियेभिर्यम वैरूपैरिह मादयस्व ।
paragraphs.translit: aṅgirobhirā gahi yajñiyebhiryama vairūpairiha mādayasva |

paragraphs.text: To sit on sacred grass at this our worship, I call Vivasvan, too, thy Father hither.
paragraphs.original: विवस्वन्तं हुवे यः पिता तेऽस्मिन्यज्ञे बर्हिष्या निषद्य
paragraphs.translit: vivasvantaṃ huve yaḥ pitā te'sminyajñe barhiṣyā niṣadya

paragraphs.text: 6. Our Fathers are Angirases, Navagvas, Atharvans, Bhrgus who deserve the Soma.
paragraphs.original: अङ्गिरसो नः पितरो नवग्वा अथर्वाणो भृगवः सोम्यासः ।
paragraphs.translit: aṅgiraso naḥ pitaro navagvā atharvāṇo bhṛgavaḥ somyāsaḥ |

paragraphs.text: May these, the Holy, look on us with favour, may we enjoy their gracious loving-kindness.
paragraphs.original: तेषां वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियानामपि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम
paragraphs.translit: teṣāṃ vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyānāmapi bhadre saumanase syāma

paragraphs.text: 7. Go forth, go forth upon the ancient pathways whereon our sires of old have gone before us.
paragraphs.original: प्रेहि प्रेहि पथिभिः पूर्व्येभिर्यत्रा नः पूर्वे पितरः परेयुः ।
paragraphs.translit: prehi prehi pathibhiḥ pūrvyebhiryatrā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ pareyuḥ |

paragraphs.text: 'Mere shalt thou look on both the Kings enjoying their sacred food, God Varuna and Yama.
paragraphs.original: उभा राजाना स्वधया मदन्ता यमं पश्यासि वरुणं च देवम्
paragraphs.translit: ubhā rājānā svadhayā madantā yamaṃ paśyāsi varuṇaṃ ca devam

paragraphs.text: 8. Meet Yama, meet the Fathers, meet the merit of free or ordered acts, in highest heaven.
paragraphs.original: सं गच्छस्व पितृभिः सं यमेनेष्टापूर्तेन परमे व्योमन् ।
paragraphs.translit: saṃ gacchasva pitṛbhiḥ saṃ yameneṣṭāpūrtena parame vyoman |

paragraphs.text: Leave sin and evil, seek anew thy dwelling, and bright with glory wear another body.
paragraphs.original: हित्वायावद्यं पुनरस्तमेहि सं गच्छस्व तन्वा सुवर्चाः
paragraphs.translit: hitvāyāvadyaṃ punarastamehi saṃ gacchasva tanvā suvarcāḥ

paragraphs.text: 9. Go hence, depart ye, fly in all directions: this place for him the Fathers have provided.
paragraphs.original: अपेत वीत वि च सर्पतातोऽस्मा एतं पितरो लोकमक्रन् ।
paragraphs.translit: apeta vīta vi ca sarpatāto'smā etaṃ pitaro lokamakran |

paragraphs.text: Yama bestows on him a place to rest in adorned with days and beams of light and waters.
paragraphs.original: अहोभिरद्भिरक्तुभिर्व्यक्तं यमो ददात्यवसानमस्मै
paragraphs.translit: ahobhiradbhiraktubhirvyaktaṃ yamo dadātyavasānamasmai

paragraphs.text: 10. Run and outspeed the two dogs, Sarama's offspring, brindled, four-eyed, upon thy happy pathway.
paragraphs.original: अति द्रव सारमेयौ श्वानौ चतुरक्षौ शबलौ साधुना पथा ।
paragraphs.translit: ati drava sārameyau śvānau caturakṣau śabalau sādhunā pathā |

paragraphs.text: Draw nigh then to the gracious-minded Fathers where they rejoice in company with Yama.
paragraphs.original: अथा पितॄन्सुविदत्राँ उपेहि यमेन ये सधमादं मदन्ति
paragraphs.translit: athā pitṝnsuvidatrām̐ upehi yamena ye sadhamādaṃ madanti

paragraphs.text: 11. And those two dogs of thine, Yama, the watchers, four-eyed, who look on men and guard the pathway,-
paragraphs.original: यौ ते श्वानौ यम रक्षितारौ चतुरक्षौ पथिरक्षी नृचक्षसौ ।
paragraphs.translit: yau te śvānau yama rakṣitārau caturakṣau pathirakṣī nṛcakṣasau |

paragraphs.text: Entrust this man, O King, to their protection, and with prosperity and health endow him.
paragraphs.original: ताभ्यामेनं परि देहि राजन्स्वस्ति चास्मा अनमीवं च धेहि
paragraphs.translit: tābhyāmenaṃ pari dehi rājansvasti cāsmā anamīvaṃ ca dhehi

paragraphs.text: 12. Dark-hued, insatiate, with distended nostrils, Yama's two envoys roam among the People;
paragraphs.original: उरूणसावसुतृपा उदुम्बलौ यमस्य दूतौ चरतो जनाँ अनु ।
paragraphs.translit: urūṇasāvasutṛpā udumbalau yamasya dūtau carato janām̐ anu |

paragraphs.text: May they restore to us a fair existence here and to-day, that we may see the sunlight.
paragraphs.original: तावस्मभ्यं दृशये सूर्याय पुनर्दातामसुमद्येह भद्रम्
paragraphs.translit: tāvasmabhyaṃ dṛśaye sūryāya punardātāmasumadyeha bhadram

paragraphs.text: 13. To Yama pour the Soma, bring to Yama consecrated gifts:
paragraphs.original: यमाय सोमं सुनुत यमाय जुहुता हविः ।
paragraphs.translit: yamāya somaṃ sunuta yamāya juhutā haviḥ |

paragraphs.text: To Yama sacrifice prepared and heralded by Agni goes.
paragraphs.original: यमं ह यज्ञो गच्छत्यग्निदूतो अरंकृतः
paragraphs.translit: yamaṃ ha yajño gacchatyagnidūto araṃkṛtaḥ

paragraphs.text: 14. Offer to Yama holy gifts enriched with butter, and draw near:
paragraphs.original: यमाय घृतवद्धविर्जुहोत प्र च तिष्ठत ।
paragraphs.translit: yamāya ghṛtavaddhavirjuhota pra ca tiṣṭhata |

paragraphs.text: So may he grant that we may live long days of life among the Gods.
paragraphs.original: स नो देवेष्वा यमद्दीर्घमायुः प्र जीवसे
paragraphs.translit: sa no deveṣvā yamaddīrghamāyuḥ pra jīvase

paragraphs.text: 15. Offer to Yama, to the King, oblation very rich in meath:
paragraphs.original: यमाय मधुमत्तमं राज्ञे हव्यं जुहोतन ।
paragraphs.translit: yamāya madhumattamaṃ rājñe havyaṃ juhotana |

paragraphs.text: Bow down before the Rsis of the ancient times, who made this path in days of old.
paragraphs.original: इदं नम ऋषिभ्यः पूर्वजेभ्यः पूर्वेभ्यः पथिकृद्भ्यः
paragraphs.translit: idaṃ nama ṛṣibhyaḥ pūrvajebhyaḥ pūrvebhyaḥ pathikṛdbhyaḥ

paragraphs.text: 16. Into the six Expanses flies the Great One in Trkadrukas.
paragraphs.original: त्रिकद्रुकेभिः पतति षळुर्वीरेकमिद्बृहत् ।
paragraphs.translit: trikadrukebhiḥ patati ṣaḷurvīrekamidbṛhat |

paragraphs.text: The Gayatri, the Trstup, all metres in Yama are contained.
paragraphs.original: त्रिष्टुब्गायत्री छन्दांसि सर्वा ता यम आहिता
paragraphs.translit: triṣṭubgāyatrī chandāṃsi sarvā tā yama āhitā
